svg.text: gfx1201 dK/dV backward — one workgroup, one KV tile
Dataflow view. Drawn in the default wide configuration; the narrower ones are special cases, listed at the bottom.
head_dim 512 · BLOCK_M 16 · num_waves 16 · split_head_dim · contraction_shards C=2 · transposed_source "derived"
TEAM_WAVES = 2C = 4 · NUM_TEAMS = 16/4 = 4 · BLOCK_N = 16 × NUM_TEAMS = 64 KV rows
What the kernel computes — and why that is four GEMMs
σ = sm_scale · softmax is row-wise over k
S = Q KT · L = logsumexp(σS) · P = exp(σS − L) · O = P V
A WMMA operand's eight per-lane elements always run along the contraction axis.
Q and dO each appear twice, contracted over a different axis each time — so each
needs two layouts. That, and nothing else, is why they are staged twice.
δ is built from O, not P — P is never materialised in full; the two forms are equal because O = P V.
σ enters exactly twice: inside the exponent, and once on dK in the epilogue. dV takes no scale — V sits downstream of the softmax, so P already carries it. dQ = σ · dS K is the other kernel.
my_packs — resident for the whole kernel
role 0 → K[:, shard] · role 1 → V[:, shard]
head_dim/(4·C) = 512/8 = 64 VGPRs (B operand of GEMM1, no transpose)
LOOP — for each Q tile of BLOCK_M = 16 rows, over the whole visited Q range
16512 B each · pad 4 spreads the banks
A operand of GEMM1/2, contracted over d
staged once, read by every wave
GEMM1 — a PARTIAL, over this wave's shard only
role 0: S_c = Σ_(d ∈ shard) Q·Kᵀ role 1: dP_c = Σ_(d ∈ shard) dO·Vᵀ
D_STEPS/C = 16 WMMA · 8 f32 accumulator per lane
write my partial to my slot
the only computed value that ever round-trips through LDS
even slots → S · odd slots → dP
own slot read back too, so every wave matches
REDUCE — every wave now holds the full S and dP
S = Σ_c S_c dP = Σ_c dP_c
a contracted index was split, so the partials must be summed
P and dS — registers only, no memory touched
dS = P · (dP − delta) → packed to f16 as WMMA B operands
lse and delta come from ROWQ; P needs no repacking — GEMM1 emits m'=q
same tile as step 3, read down the q axis
"derived": no transposed tile exists — saves 40960 B
GEMM3 / GEMM4 — accumulate, contracted over q
dVᵀ[d][kv] += dOᵀ · P dKᵀ[d][kv] += Qᵀ · dS
only this wave's d window: d ∈ [slot·D/4, (slot+1)·D/4)
accs = head_dim/(2·C) = 128 VGPRs · a free index, so no reduction
s_barrier — before the next tile overwrites QRM/DORM
accumulators stay in registers across every iteration — never spilled to LDS
dᵀ comes out per-lane-contiguous, so one v8 store per 16 columns
4 teams per workgroup, each owning a disjoint 16 KV rows
Every slot also owns dK and dV for d ∈ [slot·D/4, (slot+1)·D/4) — a quarter each, disjoint.
Pack partition (by shard) and accumulator partition (by slot) are independent.
Why the two splits differ in cost
Free index — appears in the output. Partitions with no communication.
dKᵀ[d][kv] += Qᵀ·dS d is free → slots write disjoint columns
Contracted index — summed away. Partitions only with a reduction.
S[q][kv] = Σ_d Q·Kᵀ d is contracted → partials must be summed
Same axis d, two different costs — which is why split_head_dim is free
and contraction_shards needs the PDS round-trip at step 4-5.
state = 0.75 · head_dim / C. C=1 → 384 VGPRs (spills); C=2 → 192 (fits).
Special cases — the same diagram with pieces removed
Team is 2 waves. One shard, so step 3's GEMM1 is
the whole contraction and there is nothing to reduce.
Steps 4–5 become a relay: keep mine in registers,
read only the partner's one slot.
state 0.75·D · step 7 reads a real Qᵀ/dOᵀ tile,
one ds_read_b128 instead of eight ds_read_u16.
Team is 1 wave. It holds both K and V packs and
computes both S and dP itself.
PDS is not allocated; steps 4–5 vanish entirely,
and with them two of the barriers.
state 1.5·D — fits at 128 (192 VGPRs), spills at 192.
BLOCK_N = 16 × num_waves, the widest tile of the three.
Two more LDS tiles, QTR and DOTR, filled in step 1
by global_load_tr_b128 — the hardware transposes on
the way in from VRAM, so the tile is a redistribution
Step 7 then reads them contiguously. Costs 40960 B at
head_dim 512, which is why it cannot be used there.
Sources: fmha_bwd_dkdv_gfx1201_kernel.py (structure) · fmha_tuning_bwd_dkdv_gfx1201.py (which case applies) · sdpa_lore_gfx1201.md (measurements)
